interruption.outcome: First browser batch was deliberately stopped after two failed new cases. Windows taskkill returned128 for some Chromium descendants (unsupported/no instance); the exact owned Node test launcher exited1 and its driver retained the incomplete output. Third browser batch was proactively stopped after the completed HTTP profile showed an 80.97-second 20-item page, beyond the unchanged 15-second browser limit; its exact owned launcher exited1. No unrelated process was targeted. None of the incomplete batches is final pass evidence.

scope: Modified-checkout development: actual local file-backed SQLite Worker, HTTP, immutable content-byte preflight and T5/ACK recovery. Actual React/Edge acceptance plus manual-review regression. Upstream source/admission/Runner/OCI/fence/health and manual observations are explicit protocol fixtures; no real model, OIDC/cookie login, Linux/gVisor, full product/workbench, physical cleanup or positive successor preserve/replace acceptance.

historyLatency.scope: Two local development samples, not a production service-level guarantee; browser timeout stays 15 seconds.

reproduction: Restore validation-driver.mjs and binding-driver.mjs under .cache/p130-*.mjs and raw records under .cache/p130-evidence. Driver lists exact build/type/lint/contracts/entry/regression/acceptance/browser commands. Browser requires template-local Playwright and installed Edge. pnpm check as a whole and clean-checkout tests were not run.
ackFault: Real local HTTP responses are fetched after server commit, then explicitly aborted by Playwright to simulate lost application acknowledgements. Prepare and accept are recovered only after user recovery clicks, with the same request keys/bodies/If-Match. The actual file-backed Worker is reopened before T5 recovery and content reads are then forbidden. This is controlled HTTP acknowledgement loss, not physical Runner or network-fault acceptance.
displayFixtures: REPLACE/PRESERVE_MIGRATE UI rendering and replacement-command case explicitly intercepts basis and decision HTTP responses. It does not register a real replacement decision or create a formal successor candidate or physical migration/replacement.

visualQA.check: Actual browser captures visually inspected; 390px layout verifies no horizontal overflow. Captures contain fixture identifiers only.

managementCheckRepair: First evidence lint found one unused output destructuring parameter in the copied binding driver; renamed it with the lint-approved underscore prefix. No application/test inputs or selected validation results changed. All management checks rerun.
